text:
incident-bot: Paging alert — controlplane/config-mismatch detected for tenant prod-37. Console shows routing flag 'enable_live_routing=false' while API returns true. Observed: customer-facing console errors and 502s, dataplane serving inference requests.

Maria G: oncall here, joining bridge. what's the impact? :eyes:

Ajay P: seeing elevated console errors for 12 customers; backend inference requests still 200s from dataplane. Looks like UI fetch of /v1/config returned stale data. paging routed to SRE.

Kevin L: joining. can we get logs from control-plane deploys around 1842342000-1842345600? suspect rollout truncated.

Tariq H: I grabbed controlplane logs, there's a Kafka consumer lag spike then leader change. sharing tail:
```
[controlplane] 2026-07-12T10:34:12Z WARN consumer lag=12000 topic=config-updates
[controlplane] 2026-07-12T10:35:01Z INFO leader change for partition 3
[controlplane] 2026-07-12T10:35:03Z ERROR apply_config failed for tenant=prod-37: version_mismatch
```

Maria G: dataplane logs show no error, inference tokens served fine. so hypothesis: config updates didn't reach control-plane replica used by console, but dataplane read config from cache/kv which was correct.

Ajay P: hypothesis A = config propagation stalled due to consumer lag after leader election. Hypothesis B = console caching layer read from a different control-plane instance behind an old flag.

SRE Rotation: taking handoff for next 60m. timeline so far:
- 1842342000 detect consumer lag
- 1842343000 console errors spike
- 1842343400 incident-bot paging -> oncall
- 1842343800 manual KV read shows expected value true
- 1842344500 controlplane attempted apply_config failed

Kevin L: quick mitigation — pushing forced config sync to console instances and bump config version. command:
```
$ rctl config sync --tenant prod-37 --force --target=console
# or
$ curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/configs/tenants/prod-37/sync?force=true -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

Ops-bot: ran sync, returned 200 — propagation started. monitor for errors.

Maria G: customer impact: console only. API calls for inference unaffected; recommend message to affected customers: brief note 'console may show old values — API services unaffected.'

Tariq H: after sync, console error rate dropped to baseline. need logs for the time window to complete RCA. please upload controlplane + kafka metrics + console instance ids to the incident board.

Ajay P: I'll own RCA. initial root cause: transient Kafka consumer lag + leader election led to apply_config failure on the console-facing replica. mitigation: add retry/backoff + more robust config-sync health check + alert on partition lags crossing threshold. action items:
- Ajay: produce RCA doc and timeline (ETA 24h)
- Kevin: add a canary to config-updates consumer + runbooks for forced sync
- Maria: compose customer message (non-technical)

Maria G: ack. closing bridge for now, keeping channel open for uploads. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident updated — status: mitigated, severity: P2. Incident link: https://incidents.internal/1842345678

SRE Rotation: handing off to Ajay for RCA. I'll be reachable if it reappears.

Ajay P: got it, will post RCA link when ready and tag SRE/Eng-Platform.
